8way joystick for player control. Use "A”button for attack. Use "B" button for jump. Use "C”button for special attack. SLIDING. Put joystick in down + "B” button for sliding. Use "A" button for attack. During sliding use "B” button to flip over enemy. After sliding put joystick to right and player starts running. DURING JUMP, use "B” button to throw down enemy. <>Put joystick in “up” to grab ceiling.
Put joystick "up” + "B” button to climb. =>"B" button, to jump down.
